notes: Document stance: the IT standard was restrict (A) vs permit (B); resolved to restrict because Copilot Chat is the only approved tool and others need IT approval, while the 'supports responsible use' line sets no free-use default. The library guide was delegates in both. Only-A units: kept the University Data definition, the Copilot 'protected data may be used' permission, the general transparency duty, 'Reuse and adapt with credit' and the co-creation rationale; dropped one elaboration of the Class 1/2 data sentence already coded. B found nothing A missed. Type disagreements (6): DeepSeek ban kept UNCOVERED (named-tool ban; P50 is data protection); Level 1 'no AI' row put under P01 not P05; 'clear expectations' principle to P56; 'explain the reasoning' and 'decide what students should be able to do' to P09 not P41/P56; the Level 1 cell was split (P41 plus a P26 drafts unit). Phase and modality disagreements were mostly about whether a descriptive sentence is informs vs should, and whether process-evidence advice is when-misuse. Several cells held two suggestions (reflection, syllabus note, drafts) and were split into separate units, adding 3 units beyond the matched set. unit_stance was normalized so disclosure and verification duties are require.
